nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable initialized to 10**18, used as the fake reserve0 value returned by getReserves.
Public uint256 state variable initialized to 10**18, used as the fake reserve1 value returned by getReserves.
Public view function that returns hardcoded/manipulated reserve values (dai, tree) and a fixed blockTimestampLast of 100000, mimicking a Uniswap pair getReserves interface.
Named return variable of getReserves assigned from the dai state variable, exposed as reserve0.
Named return variable of getReserves assigned from the tree state variable, exposed as reserve1.
Named return variable of getReserves assigned the constant 100000, faking the last block timestamp of the pair.

edges.reason: The dai state variable value is read and assigned into the _reserve0 return variable inside getReserves.
The tree state variable value is read and assigned into the _reserve1 return variable inside getReserves.
_reserve0 is returned by getReserves as the first output value.
_reserve1 is returned by getReserves as the second output value.
_blockTimestampLast is returned by getReserves as the third output value.

normalization_plan.reason: _reserve0 is only a temporary holder for the dai value returned by getReserves, so it should be folded into the getReserves function node.
_reserve1 is only a temporary holder for the tree value returned by getReserves, so it should be folded into the getReserves function node.
_blockTimestampLast is a constant-valued return holder in getReserves and should be folded into the getReserves function node.
